text:
Ravi (AE): quick one — Liam from LumenAI wants the 4-week sandbox acceptance criteria finalized. Their asks: p95 latency target, cost cap per 1M requests, and quality parity checks. Can we confirm gating and who owns each?

Taylor (SE): sure. need their traffic mix (sustained vs bursts) and seq-length distribution to size batching. also ask for the golden prompt set for eval.

Liam (Buyer): profile: sustained ~30 qps, bursts to 90 qps lasting ~2-3m, avg input 160 tokens, avg output 70 tokens, occasional long contexts to 800 tokens. Monthly estimate ~1.2M request-equivalents.

Marta (SRE): for that volume I'd recommend a dedicated pool with burst autoscaling + canary on hosted. propose 95p latency goal under mixed load and a rollback window if p95 > target for 15 continuous minutes.

Taylor (SE): propose acceptance gates:
1) Performance gate: p95 <= 280ms measured over a 48h canary with the agreed traffic replay; error rate <0.5%.
2) Cost gate: modeled monthly cost <= $375/1M (we'll provide tokenization math and two scenarios: hosted vs reserved dedicated).
3) Quality gate: evaluation on their golden set: relative ROUGE-L drop <=1.2% and top-1 accuracy within 0.03 of baseline. If quantized variant used, must still meet these thresholds.

Ravi (AE): add security/compliance gate: KMS integration (customer CMK option), SSO (SAML), and audit-log retention 90 days. Compliance must ack before kickoff.

Liam (Buyer): also need a clear rollback and notification matrix — who is paged, expected MTTR, and how we revert traffic.

Marta (SRE): rollback matrix: automated traffic shift to baseline model if any perf gate triggers; on-call list: Taylor (SE) then Marta (SRE) then Ravi (AE). MTTR target 30 minutes for traffic rollback. Runbook will include thresholds and steps.

Taylor (SE): testing plan (short):
- Run 3h synthetic replay: sustained 30 qps + periodic 90 qps spikes
- Seq length distrib: p50=200, p95=720
- Capture p50/p95/p99, error rate, token burn
- Repeat with fp16 and 8-bit quantized models for cost/quality comparison

Ravi (AE): timeline & owners:
- Today EOD: Taylor uploads golden set + run harness config
- +24h: Marta runs perf tests and posts p95 numbers
- +48h: Diego (Eng) to post cost scenarios (dedicated vs hosted)
- +72h: finalize acceptance doc and schedule 30-min review with Liam
Owners: Taylor (tests & golden-set), Marta (perf runs & runbook), Ravi (customer comms & acceptance doc), Diego (cost calc).

compliance-bot: attached: soc2-summary.pdf (internal), kms-integration-flow.txt, saml-ssourl-example.txt :white_check_mark:

Liam (Buyer): ok — please make cost calc explicit about tokenization assumptions and include sensitivity to batch window. Also need clarity on data retention for RAG index during the sandbox.

Taylor (SE): will include tokenization examples and a sensitivity table for batching windows (0-50ms) and their impact on p95 and token burn. We'll include a small appendix on RAG data retention options.

Ravi (AE): great — I'll collate into a single acceptance doc and send for sign-off once assets are in. Meeting invite for Thursday 10am PT after Taylor's run. Thanks all :thumbsup:
